reason: I don't drive and my son or the neighbour already brings what I need, and they shop at the supermarket themselves. I would not put my list on WhatsApp and then go to a pickup point at 6 to 8 in the evening for a bag.
objection: I'm a few minutes from Tawfeer, why would I pay someone to shop for me? And there is no home delivery, so I would still need someone to carry the bag from the pickup point, and I would be paying a fee on top of it.
would_change_my_mind: If they brought the bag to my door and the $2 was clearly less than what my family spends on petrol and time going down to Jbeil.
